items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I remember one night when my sister Naomi was alive

ctx.x: Uh huh. Talk about your early influence with music. What was the first influence in listening to music, and how you got interested in it?
Well, my father was a record collector. I remember one night when my sister Naomi was alive -- as young
as we were, I remember she and I playing the Victrola which "His Master's Voice" was one of the High Boy Victor things with the megaphone and and the dog on it?
